paite: Huchi in Baasha kalh in Hanani tapa Jehu kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

paite: "Leivui a pan ka hon domsang a, ka mi Israelte tung ah heutu in ka hon bawl hi. Nang Jeroboam lampi zuih na tawn a, akhelhnate a hon hehsak ding in ka mi Israelte thil na hihkhialsak hi.
english: “Because I exalted you out of the dust and made you prince over my people Israel, and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have made my people Israel to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins,

paite: Ngai in, Baasha leh a-inkote ka hihmang ding hi. Huchi in Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote bang mai in na inkote ka bawl ding.
english: behold, I will utterly sweep away Baasha and his house; and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

paite: Baasha inkote lak a mi khopi a si peuhmah ui in ane dia; a-inkote lak a mi gamlak a si peuhmah tungleng vasate'n ane ding uh," chi in.
english: The dogs will eat Baasha’s descendants who die in the city; and he who dies of his in the field, the birds of the sky will eat.”

paite: Baasha tanchin dangte, athilhihte leh athilhihtheihdante Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Baasha apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Tirzah ah avui ua; asik in atapa Elah alal hi.
english: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Baasha leh a-inkote tungtang thu ah akhutsuak a TOUPA hehsak dia Jeroboam inkote batna nei a TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou mahmah ahih ziak leh amah athah ziak in Hanani tapa zawlnei Jehu zang a agen TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came by the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha and against his house, both because of all the evil that he did in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam, and because he struck him.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-gukna ah Baasha tapa Elah, Tirzah ah Israelte tung ah alal pan a, kum nih alal hi,
heading: Israel Kumpipa Elah
english: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah the son of Baasha began to reign over Israel in Tirzah for two years.

paite: Asikha Zimri, akangtalai kimkhat tung a heutu in Tirzah ah amah gukthah asawm hi. Huchih lai in, Tirzah ah insung lam heutu Arza inn ah amah zukham in a-om hi.
english: His servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him. Now he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza, who was over the household in Tirzah;

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-sagih in Zimri lut in ava sual a, athat a, asik in alalta hi.
english: and Zimri went in and struck him and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned in his place.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ahong lal pan a, alaltutphah a ahong tuttak in, Baasha inko tengteng athat vek a; atanaute leh alawmte lak a mi pasal photphot khat leng ahawi kei hi.
english: When he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, he attacked all the house of Baasha. He didn’t leave him a single one who urinates on a wall among his relatives or his friends.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Jehu zang a Baasha kalh a agen, TOUPA thu bang in, Zimri in Baasha inko tengteng athat vek hi;
english: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

paite: TOUPA, Israelte’ Pathian, hehsak dia aginatlouhna ua, atohthoh ua, Baasha khelhnate leh atapa Elah khelhnate a amaute akhelh ua, huai mah a Israelte akhelhsak ziak un.
english: for all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they sinned and with which they made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

paite: Elah tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmnih-le-sagihna ah Zimri, Tirzah ah ni sagih alal hi. Philistiate neihsa, Gibbethon a mite'n a-um uhi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Zimri
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

paite: A-um mite'n, "Zimri in aguksawm a, kumpipa athat," chih agen uh ana za ua; huchi in Israel tengteng in sepaih heutu, Omri, huai ni in agiahmun uah Israelte tung a kumpipa in abawl uhi.
english: The people who were encamped heard that Zimri had conspired, and had also killed the king. Therefore all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king over Israel that day in the camp.

paite: Omri bel Israel tengteng toh Gibbethon a pan in ahohtou ua, Tirzah ava um uhi.
english: Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Israel with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Zimri in khua ala uh chih atheih in, kumpipa' inn a kulh ah atailut a, kumpipa' inn ah akibuhal a, asita hi;
english: When Zimri saw that the city was taken, he went into the fortified part of the king’s house and burned the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

paite: TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou mahmah hih a akhelhnate ziak leh Jeroboam lampi tawn a Israelte thil hihkhialsak a, akhelh ziak in.
english: for his sins which he sinned in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did to make Israel to sin.

paite: Zimri tanchin dangte leh asawmgukna thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he committed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Israel mite pawl nih in akikhenta ua; mipi kimkhat in Ginath tapa Tibni kumpipa dia bawl tum in azui ua; akimkhat in Omri azui uhi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Omri
english: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king, and half followed Omri.

paite: Himahleh Omri zuite'n Ginath tapa Tibni zuite azou ua: huchi in Tibni asi a, Omri ahong lalta hi.
english: But the people who followed Omri prevailed against the people who followed Tibni the son of Ginath; so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmthum-le-khatna ah Omri Israelte tung ah alal pan a, kum sawm-le-nih alal a: Tirzah ah kum guk alal hi.
english: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri began to reign over Israel for twelve years. He reigned six years in Tirzah.

paite: Shemer a Samaria mual dangka talent nih in alei a; mual tung ah khua asat a, akhosat min huai neipa Shemer min tam in Samaria asa hi.
english: He bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver; and he built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, Samaria, after the name of Shemer, the owner of the hill.

paite: Omri in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih a, ama a mi tengteng sang in thil ahihkhial thupi tuamse hi.
english: Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.

paite: Nebat tapa Jeroboam dan tengteng ala a, aginatlouhna ziak ua TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian hehsak dia Israelte thil ahihkhelhsak bang in akhial samta hi.
english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

paite: Omri thilhih tanchin dangte leh athilhihtheihdan ahihlat thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he showed, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

paite: Huchi in Omri apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, Samaria ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahab ahong lal hi.
english: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria; and Ahab his son reigned in his place.

paite: Judah kumpipa Asa lal akum sawmthum-le-giatna ah Israelte tung ah Omri tapa Ahab alal pan hi. Omri tapa Ahab, Samaria ah kum sawmnih-le-nih Israelte tung ah alal hi,
heading: Israel Kumpipa Ahab
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

paite: Omri tapa Ahab in ama a mi tengteng sang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou mahmah ahih hi.
english: Ahab the son of Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight above all that were before him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna bang hih sam bangmah lou a ngai hileh kilawmtak in, Zidonte kumpipa Ethbaal tanu Jezebel zi in anei a, Baal nna sem in abia hi.
english: As if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, he took as wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and went and served Baal and worshiped him.

paite: Samaria a Baal inn alam ah Baal a ding in maitam adoh hi.
english: He raised up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

paite: Ahab in Asherah abawl a; ama a Israel kumpipa tengteng sang in Ahab in TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian hehsakna thil anak hih tungtuan hi.
english: Ahab made the Asherah; and Ahab did more yet to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger than all the kings of Israel who were before him.

paite: Alal lai in Bethel mi Hiel in Jeriko khua asat a; atachil Abiram tanloh in asuangphum aphum hi. TOUPA'N Nun tapa Joshua zang a ana gensa bang in, anautum Segub tanloh hial in akulh kongkhakte adingkhesak hi.
english: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.
